mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, display_title, icon_key, latest_version, listed, revision, created_at, updated_at, bundled, bundled_version
uuid, external_id, skill_uuid, skill_external_id, version, name, description, directory, state, s3_bucket, s3_key, size_bytes, sha256, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM builtin_skills WHERE external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO builtin_skills (uuid, external_id, display_title, icon_key, listed) VALUES (#{skill.UUID}, #{skill.ExternalID}, #{skill.DisplayTitle}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{skill.IconKey}, ''), 'blocks'), false) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO builtin_skills (uuid, external_id, display_title, icon_key, latest_version, bundled_version, bundled, listed) VALUES (#{skill.UUID}, #{skill.ExternalID}, #{skill.DisplayTitle}, #{skill.IconKey}, #{skill.LatestVersion}, #{skill.LatestVersion}, true, true) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET bundled = true, display_title = EXCLUDED.display_title, bundled_version = EXCLUDED.bundled_version, deleted_at = NULL, latest_version = CASE WHEN builtin_skills.latest_version IS NULL OR builtin_skills.latest_version = builtin_skills.bundled_version OR builtin_skills.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.latest_version ELSE builtin_skills.latest_version END, revision = builtin_skills.revision + CASE WHEN (builtin_skills.bundled, builtin_skills.display_title, builtin_skills.bundled_version, builtin_skills.deleted_at) IS DISTINCT FROM (true, EXCLUDED.display_title, EXCLUDED.bundled_version, NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CASE WHEN (builtin_skills.bundled, builtin_skills.display_title, builtin_skills.bundled_version, builtin_skills.deleted_at) IS DISTINCT FROM (true, EXCLUDED.display_title, EXCLUDED.bundled_version, NULL) THEN now() ELSE builtin_skills.updated_at END RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE builtin_skills SET icon_key = #{skill.IconKey}, latest_version = #{skill.LatestVersion}, listed = #{skill.Listed}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE uuid = #{skill.UUID} AND revision = #{skill.Revision} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE builtin_skills SET deleted_at = now(), listed = false, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE uuid = #{skill.UUID} AND revision = #{skill.Revision} AND NOT bundled AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM builtin_skill_versions WHERE skill_uuid = #{skillUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND state = 'published' ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM builtin_skill_versions WHERE skill_uuid = #{skillUUID} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO builtin_skill_versions (uuid, external_id, skill_uuid, skill_external_id, version, name, description, directory, state, s3_bucket, s3_key, size_bytes, sha256, created_at) VALUES (#{version.UUID}, #{version.ExternalID}, #{version.SkillUUID}, #{version.SkillExternalID}, #{version.Version}, #{version.Name}, #{version.Description}, #{version.Directory}, 'draft', #{version.S3Bucket}, #{version.S3Key}, #{version.SizeBytes}, #{version.SHA256}, #{version.CreatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE builtin_skill_versions SET state = 'published' WHERE skill_uuid = #{skillUUID} AND version = #{version} AND state = 'draft' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT e.uuid, e.skill_uuid, e.actor_uuid, COALESCE(u.external_id, '') AS actor_id, COALESCE(u.name, '') AS actor_name, e.action, e.version, e.created_at FROM system_skill_events e LEFT JOIN users u ON u.uuid = e.actor_uuid WHERE e.skill_uuid = #{skillUUID} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_skill_events (skill_uuid, actor_uuid, action, version) VALUES (#{event.SkillUUID}, #{event.ActorUUID}, #{event.Action}, #{event.Version})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM builtin_skill_versions WHERE s3_key = #{key})
